meaning: Total rent attributable to bottlenecks in layer l at date t, summed across all actors. Non-negative, and higher when scarcity in that layer binds more tightly.
The vector of the five layer rents at date t.
Regime parameter for the intensity of AI technological abundance. It shifts the level and the composition of the rent vector: a higher value can lower some layer rents and raise others.
Actor i's share of effective control or residual claims over the rents of layer l, between 0 and 1. The shares of all actors in one layer sum to 1.
Total rent income of actor i at date t: the sum over layers of the actor's share times the layer rent.
The part of actor i's rent income that comes from layer l: the actor's share times the layer rent. Table 1 reports the direction of its change.
Reference bundle for a minimum standard of living: energy services, shelter, basic health care, basic mobility, connectivity.
Minimum expenditure needed to obtain the reference bundle at date t.
Disposable resources of household h at date t: labor income, plus the household's claims on layer rents, plus net transfers.
Labor income of household h at date t.
Net transfers received by household h at date t.
Household h's effective claim on the rents of layer l, between 0 and 1, held directly or through asset ownership and intermediaries.
Price-relevant rent intensity of layer l: the layer rent times a scaling factor nu, for example rent per unit of bundle-relevant usage.
Non-negative factor that maps the total rent of layer l into a comparable intensity.
Competitive production costs of the reference bundle.
How strongly the rent intensity of layer l enters the expenditure needed to obtain the bundle. Non-negative.
Index of a layer, from 1 to 5: physical, infrastructural, capabilities, institutional, jurisdictional. The set of the five layers is written with a calligraphic L.
Index of an actor or a representative group: a firm, a platform, a state, an institutional investor or a household. There are N of them.
Index of a household. The set of households is written with a calligraphic H.
Date. Written as the last subscript.
Change after large-scale AI deployment. Table 1 reports the direction of the change in pi for each layer and, in its net column, of the change in Pi.
